text:
ramon_cs: FYI Maplecroft reporting p99 embeds jumping from ~250ms to 2.3s since 09:12 UTC. Customer seeing timeouts in their upstream. They suspect noisy-tenant. Requesting quick mitigation (allowlist/reservation) before business hours EMEA.

sophia_support: Thanks @ramon_cs - what model + route? Any request IDs?

ramon_cs: route: /v1/embeddings (model: redwood-embed-lite-v2). Example req id from their logs: req_20260317_091223_abc123

alice_oncall: I'm looking at metrics now. There's a correlated burst on shard us-east-2-gpu-5 at 09:11:50. p99 cpu spike + queue length. Could be noisy neighbor or long-gen batch. Tagging @ben_infra

ben_infra: deploy-bot shows no infra deploys at that time. However autoscaler didn't add nodes - hitting reservation limits. Can we grant temporary reservation for Maplecroft on that pool? Also suggest immediate per-tenant throttle bump to reduce head-of-line.

infra-oncall: created ephemeral reservation 5k tokens/min for tenant maplecroft at 09:28 UTC and added to quiet-allowlist on us-east-2-gpu-5. Policy id: res-elm-20260317. See command:
```
redwoodctl reservations create --tenant maplecroft --pool us-east-2-gpu-5 --rate 5000 --ttl 2h
redwoodctl policy allowlist add --tenant maplecroft --pool us-east-2-gpu-5 --reason "p99 tail spike"
```

deploy-bot: reservation res-elm-20260317 created by infra-oncall.

alice_oncall: after reservation took effect p99 for Maplecroft on that pool dropped from 2.3s -> 320ms within 3 minutes. Global p99 still slightly elevated; we should reroute a fraction of traffic off that pool to stabilize.

ben_infra: started gradual reroute: updated routing weight for maplecroft to prefer us-east-2-gpu-3 (less loaded). Command:
```
redwoodctl routes update --tenant maplecroft --route embeddings --weights us-east-2-gpu-3:0.7,us-east-2-gpu-5:0.3
```

sophia_support: Confirming with customer now. Ramon, can you ask them to validate requests for regressions? Also ask if they started a batch job at ~09:10.

ramon_cs: Customer says they kicked off a backfill at 09:05 - large batch of 200k docs. They had assumed backfills would be queued. They will move it to off-peak or throttle their job.

alice_oncall: Root cause looks like tenant backfill causing long KV cache pressure + queueing on a single hot shard. Mitigations: reservation + reroute + customer-side backoff. Next steps: schedule RCA, recommend permanent reservation or quota limits for large backfills, add guidance to docs about bulk embed jobs.

sophia_support: Customer acknowledged and will throttle backfill. They want an ETA for permanent quota. Ramon to follow up.

ramon_cs: Customer happy for now, thanks team :tada:

ben_infra: I'll open a follow-up ticket to propose a 'bulk job' quota and runtime detection to auto-redirect heavy jobs.

alice_oncall: marking thread resolved; monitoring for 1h.
